topic: Pick a shared productivity tool for the project group

scenario.topic: Pick a shared productivity tool for the project group
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us in a productivity tool: ease of use, integration, cost, or customization?

options.name: Asana Premium Plan
options.upside: Strong task management features with many integrations
options.tradeoff: Can be overwhelming for new users due to feature complexity
options.concern: Some users find the interface cluttered and slow with large projects
options.best_for: teams needing robust task tracking and app integrations

options.name: Trello Business Class
options.upside: Highly visual and flexible kanban boards with easy customization
options.tradeoff: Less suited for complex task dependencies or detailed reporting
options.concern: Limited offline functionality and occasional sync delays reported
options.best_for: teams prioritizing visual workflow and customization

options.name: Microsoft Planner with Office 365
options.upside: Seamless integration with Microsoft 365 suite and familiar interface
options.tradeoff: Limited advanced features and customization compared to competitors
options.concern: Only practical if all team members use Microsoft 365 ecosystem
options.best_for: teams fully invested in Microsoft products seeking simplicity

options.name: ClickUp Unlimited Plan
options.upside: Extremely customizable with powerful features at a lower price point
options.tradeoff: Steeper learning curve and occasional interface clutter
options.concern: Some users report bugs and inconsistent updates
options.best_for: teams wanting maximum flexibility and feature depth on a budget

shared_context: The project group has exactly 4 participants
The budget for the tool subscription is capped at $50 per month
The tool must support real-time collaboration and task tracking

personas.background: Olga manages complex projects and values highly customizable tools that can adapt to varied workflows.
